Admin Console
specs.value: Web server hosted locally on Spot; browser-based (Chrome) system settings; accessible from Spot App
specs.note: Pages: User Management, Network Setup, Software Update, Spot License, Logs, About, Payloads, General Settings, Battery, WiFi Dashboard, Visualizer

specs.label: Admin Console functions
specs.value: User management; network setup and diagnostics; software update; license install; log management/upload, image logging toggle; rename; cumulative runtime data; payload config; auto log upload toggle; fiducial size/ranges; factory reset; battery health metrics; WiFi connection history; limb/payload visualizer

specs.label: Spot license
specs.value: License files required for Spot operation, installed via Admin Console

specs.label: Software support policy
specs.value: Current and previous minor releases (e.g. x.1 and x.0) plus all patch versions
specs.note: Do not skip intermediate major/minor releases

specs.label: Software update method
specs.value: Upload .bde file via Admin Console (Spot on Dock or Power Supply); tablet Spot App updates bundled with robot software
specs.note: Downloads at support.bostondynamics.com/s/spot/downloads

specs.label: Tablet app software
specs.value: Spot App (.apk) for Android; updates bundled with robot software or manual install via USB/download

specs.label: Attachment software updates
specs.value: Per-attachment versions with compatibility chart on Spot Downloads page

specs.label: Diagnostic log capture
specs.value: REPORT BUG: previous 30 s of operational data; START LOG: up to 10 min of new data (continues up to 21 s after controller connection loss)

specs.label: Factory reset
specs.value: Admin Console > General Settings; ~5 min; resets accounts, network, nickname, payloads, logs, data; keeps software version and license; optional Zeroize SSD

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: SSD (writable portion can be zeroized on factory reset)
specs.note: Capacity not stated

specs.label: Additional API licenses

specs.note: Outside intended use; regulatory declarations no longer apply

specs.label: SDK language
specs.value: Python SDK
specs.note: Flexible API and Python SDK

specs.label: Ethernet

specs.value: Aluminum T-slot rails along top left and top right edges of body; accept T-slot nuts such as Misumi HNTR5-5

specs.label: Payload port locations
specs.value: Forward and rear payload ports provide power and data

specs.note: Overhang front/rear reduces maneuverability

specs.value: 20.43 kg total combined over top of body; best with combined CoM between front and rear hips, ideally centered; keep CoM low for self-right

specs.note: Machine screws into T-slot nuts; do not over-tighten

specs.value: M5 machine screws into T-slot nuts; some attachments use locating pins in top panel holes

specs.label: Payload port connection
specs.value: Ribbon-cable connector fastened with screws; unused ports must be capped (Spot cannot operate with an exposed payload port)

specs.label: Payload software configuration
specs.value: Configured in Admin Console Payloads page (some auto-register; front or rear mount configs); attach/detach toggle in Spot App; stored configs reused

specs.label: Payload interface documentation
specs.value: Payload Developer Guide; Robot Electrical Interface (dev.bostondynamics.com/docs/payload/)

specs.label: Payload max weight (product page)
specs.note: Marketing payload capacity on product page and datasheet; IFU §1.5.2 gives max recommended attachment mass 20.43 kg

Payload port connector
specs.value: DB25 (2 ports)

specs.label: Payload port supply voltage
specs.note: Unregulated DC, 150 W per port

specs.label: Payload integration
specs.value: Software API and hardware interface control document available

specs.label: Spot Arm
specs.value: Optional actuated attachment (Spot Arm with gripper and gripper camera); SpotCheck recalibrates gripper and checks arm joint sensors
specs.note: Requires separate risk assessment; see Spot Arm Information for Use

specs.label: Motors per leg
specs.note: Three motors in each leg

specs.label: Leg joint layout
specs.value: Ball joint at hip (upper leg to body); hinged knee (upper to lower leg); rounded foot with rubberized pad

specs.label: Foot type
specs.value: Rounded foot with rubberized pad

specs.label: Foot treads
specs.value: Replaceable foot treads; inspect regularly

specs.label: E-Stop button
specs.value: Red E-Stop button at top rear right corner of body (model 04-00143531-401 only); press to activate, twist clockwise to release
specs.note: Emergency Stop function compliant with ISO 13850; triggers safety-related stop

specs.label: Intended use
specs.value: Professional use of locomotion and carrying capabilities in industrial, restricted or supervised environments; in dedicated, demarcated areas; attachments for sensing, monitoring or other non-contact interaction
specs.note: Not intended for collaborative applications (concurrent human-robot activity sharing space/equipment)

specs.label: Explicitly prohibited uses
specs.value: Underwater and airborne applications; Use as a weapon or to enable any weapon; Use as or enabling a Certified Medical Device (healthcare facility access subject to limitations); Personal care, medical treatment or life-critical applications; Use in home environments; Transportation of persons or animals; Transportation of hazardous materials or substances; Intentionally harming any person; Any illegal purpose; Use as a climbing aid; Interfering with Spot's sensors or altering environment to impair sensors or locomotion

specs.label: Operational stop triggers
specs.value: Signal loss; fall detection (motors de-energized, 'smart freeze'); low battery (sits, motors off); controller input; mission interrupt signal (fiducial-triggered)

specs.label: Keep-out distance at bottom of active staircase
specs.note: Do not stand on stairs, below open rails, or within 2 m of the bottom of a staircase where Spot is active

specs.label: Safety-related stop category
specs.value: Stop Category 0 (EN IEC 60204-1), de-energizes all motors
specs.note: Triggered when contact on safe input I1 is opened

specs.label: Max response time of stopping function
Safe input
specs.value: I1 = pin 19 on payload port; use only one port (front or rear); default 6-19 pair normally closed (NC); reset when 6-19 pair closed
specs.note: Spot will not work without a cap or properly configured attachment on each port; with a cap the stopping function is disabled

specs.label: Stopping safety function
specs.value: ISO 13849-1:2023 Category 1, Performance Level c

specs.label: Max stopping distance (safety-related stop)
specs.note: On flat ground; can increase on uneven/sloped surfaces

specs.label: Emergency Stop standard
specs.note: Additional E-Stop devices may be fitted via payload-port safe input

specs.label: Obstacle avoidance
specs.value: Perception system of five depth cameras (two front, one rear, one each side); gaps extend at 45° from each hip, front gaps close ~2 m from robot; rear gaps extend past depth range

specs.label: Default minimum distance to obstacles
specs.note: Approximately

specs.label: Max additional obstacle avoidance cushion
specs.note: Set in Robot Controls panel

specs.label: Foreseeable hazardous exposure duration
specs.value: <1 min per interaction (automatic mode); <10% of total usage time (restricted access areas); several minutes up to 1 h (manual mode)

specs.label: Low-occurrence condition exposure limit
specs.note: Low occurrence does not hold when qualified personnel present >25% of total usage time or affected people up to 25%

specs.label: EMC emission
specs.value: IEC 61000-6-4 (heavy industrial environments)

specs.label: EMC immunity
specs.value: IEC 61000-6-2 (industrial environments)

specs.label: ESD immunity level
specs.value: +/-4 kV direct contact, +/-8 kV air discharge

specs.label: Laser class
specs.value: Class 1 Laser Product (EN/IEC 60825-1 Ed. 2 (2007) and Ed. 3 (2014))
specs.note: Five stereo camera systems contain a Class 1 laser projection system

specs.label: Airborne noise
specs.value: Determined by operating environment (e.g. much quieter on padded carpet than on metal stairs); no fixed figure given

specs.label: Accidental impact duration while walking
specs.note: Short event followed by recoil; impacts only with lower body (feet and lower legs)

specs.label: Minimum timeframe for accelerations/pattern changes
specs.note: Accelerations and any change of pattern do not occur in a timeframe shorter than 1 second

specs.label: Fall severity elevation threshold
specs.note: Elevation <1100 mm: low-severity minor impacts with lower body; >1100 mm: high severity possible

specs.label: Flat/non-elevated ground reference
specs.note: Elevation <300 mm reference situation for accidental impacts

specs.label: Leg state after de-energization
specs.value: Legs are not locked during and after motor de-energization; body lowered in control before full de-energization when possible

specs.label: Hip pivot joint pinch point depth
specs.note: Approximately 5 cm beneath external surface of hips and legs, single finger-size gap; severity moderate, occurrence low

specs.label: Pinch points
specs.value: Hip pivot joint (finger-size gap, moderate severity, low occurrence); hip rolling joint (wide surface, low severity); knee joints
specs.note: Keep hands away from knee and hip joints except when grabbing handles

specs.label: Clearance around Spot for setup/operation
specs.note: At least 2 m in all directions

specs.label: Controller stop commands
specs.value: STOP (immediately suspends motion); CUT POWER (fully de-energizes motors; via button shortcut or STOP twice)
specs.note: Take precedence over all active commands

specs.label: Clearance required for self-right / fall recovery
specs.note: Clear 1 m radius around Spot

specs.label: Recommended bystander distance
specs.note: Stay >=2 m from Spot at all times; always give right of way; do not enter staircases/confined spaces where Spot is active

specs.label: Markings
specs.value: CE (EU); UKCA; FCC; ISED Canada; RCM (R-NZ); KC (Korea); Japan radio (MIC/TELEC); ICASA (South Africa); IMDA (Singapore)
specs.note: Nameplate/label in battery compartment

specs.label: EU directives (DoC)
specs.value: Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC; EMC Directive 2014/30/EU; Radio Equipment Directive 2014/53/EU
specs.note: EU DoC dated Jan 9, 2024; applies to s/n BD-33390001 or higher

specs.label: EU authorized representative / technical file
specs.value: Alura Group BV, Kroonwiel 2, 6003 BT Weert, The Netherlands

specs.label: Joint-level/choreography API clearance
specs.note: Full-separation safeguards at min 2 m (joint-level); >=2 m clear space on flat, stable, high-friction surface (choreography); use wireless E-Stop

specs.label: Collision avoidance
specs.value: Maintains set distance from stationary objects

specs.label: EMC (US)
specs.value: FCC Part 15B
specs.ref: p.2 Safety and Compliance, United States

specs.label: Radio equipment (US)
specs.value: Incorporates a FCC Part 68 certified radio system (as stated)
specs.ref: p.2 Safety and Compliance, United States

specs.label: Modes of operation
specs.value: Manual (remote controller with camera view); Automatic (Autowalk mission record and replay)

specs.label: Installation requirements
specs.value: No special installation fixtures (no anchoring, anti-vibration pads); setup on flat, stable, clean surface

specs.label: User accounts
specs.value: Default user and admin accounts (credentials on battery-compartment label); roles: Admin (manage users, update software), Limited Access (no user/software/network/factory-reset changes, no automatic operation, no data download, screenshots or Admin Console)

specs.label: Controller
specs.value: Spot tablet controller: handheld touchscreen Android computer running Spot App (ships with Spot); or Orbit browser application on a computer
specs.note: Tablet or compatible device with Spot App required to record missions

specs.label: Multiple controllers
specs.value: Multiple controllers can pair simultaneously to observe; only one operates at a time; control can be passed (TAKE CONTROL)

specs.label: Signal-loss behavior
specs.value: Manual: halt with motors on and wait (or AutoReturn if enabled); Automatic: continue mission; limited by controller supervision setting

specs.label: Controller supervision timeout, STRICT (default)
specs.note: Then operational stop (sit, motors off)

specs.label: AutoReturn max backtrack radius
specs.note: Configurable; disabled by default; manual operation only

specs.label: Startup sequence
specs.value: 1) Power on computers (hold power 2 s); 2) reset motor lockout; 3) start motors from remote controller
